subject: Agriculture
title: Soil Horizons
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Soil Horizons.

hook.text: Dig a pit in the ground and you'll see layers—each a different color, texture, and story.

buildup.text: The O horizon sits on top: leaf litter, dead plants, and decomposing organic matter.

discovery.text: Below that, the A horizon—topsoil—is where most roots grow and most farming happens.

twist.text: The B horizon collects minerals washed down from above. It's dense, often clay-rich, and hard to dig.

climax.text: At the bottom, the C horizon is barely weathered rock—the raw material for future soil above it.

punchline.text: Soil tells its history in layers, if you dig deep enough.

quiz.question: Which soil horizon is most important for farming?
